$comment: Provenance of the vendored GBrain source tree. Machine-readable record required by the Breadboard GBrain integration (docs/GBRAIN_INTEGRATION.md). Do NOT claim immutable upstream provenance from the VERSION file alone; see verification below.
name: gbrain
declaredVersionSource: gbrain/VERSION and gbrain/package.json (self-declared by the vendored tree)
upstreamRepositoryUrl: UNKNOWN — the vendored package.json declares no repository field and no upstream remote is present in this checkout.
upstreamCommitSha: UNKNOWN — the GBrain source is committed directly inside the Breadboard repository (no nested .git, no submodule pin), so the exact upstream commit SHA cannot be derived from this checkout.
importMethod: vendored (copied into gbrain/ and committed to the Breadboard repository)

localPatches.justification: PGlite/Emscripten can reject initialization with a plain object. Preserve a bounded, JSON-safe snapshot of its own diagnostic fields instead of collapsing the production failure to [object Object].

localPatchPolicy: One narrow Breadboard diagnostic patch is retained in gbrain/src/core/pglite-engine.ts and recorded above with its focused test. The production adapter otherwise imports GBrain only through its public interfaces; future source drift must be added to localPatches with justification and verification.

contentChecksums.method: git tree object SHA-1 (canonical, reproducible from `git rev-parse`); gbrainSrcTreeSha is the reviewed patched source tree, while gbrainTreeSha is the imported whole-tree baseline at breadboardCommit

reproducibleComparisonProcedure.description: Because the exact upstream SHA is unknown, verify the vendored tree against the tagged upstream release instead.
steps: 1. Obtain the upstream GBrain source for the tagged release v0.42.62.0 (from the upstream distribution the tree was vendored from).
2. Copy the vendored tree to a scratch dir: `cp -r gbrain /tmp/gbrain-vendored` and remove build artifacts (`rm -rf /tmp/gbrain-vendored/node_modules`).
3. Remove build artifacts from the upstream checkout too, then diff: `diff -ru <upstream>/src /tmp/gbrain-vendored/src`.
4. The diff must contain only changes recorded in localPatches above; any additional diff lines are unreviewed local drift and MUST be recorded with justification before release.
5. Re-derive the current vendored tree SHA at any time with `git rev-parse HEAD:gbrain/src` and compare against contentChecksums.gbrainSrcTreeSha.

integrationBoundary: gbrain-adapter/src/backends/gbrain-backend.ts wraps this tree via createEngine, importFromContent, searchKeyword, searchVector, getLinks/getBacklinks, addLinksBatch, getPage, addSource, embedQuery — all public exports. No private field access beyond engine.executeRaw (a public method used throughout gbrain core) for lightweight count(*) stats.
